sentences.en: Sami is very well respected and beloved in the congregation.
sentences.zh: 萨米在会众中非常受尊敬和喜爱。

sentences.en: Sami was described as a beloved pastor by his congregation.
sentences.zh: 他的会众称他为一位深受爱戴的牧师。

sentences.en: The church congregation was moved by the fine sermon.
sentences.zh: 教堂里的会众被精彩的布道深深打动了。

senses.zh: （教堂里的）会众,集会,集合,人群
